discovery_notes: Top-up of packet 76 (WDW OE 2020-2022); 27 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet. Filled Christmas 2020-2022, Halloween 2021-2022, Princess 2022 sets, park-specific (Pandora, Everest, KiteTails, Haunted Mansion, Hollywood Tower Hotel, World Showcase pavilions), resort pins, Galaxy's Edge and Toy Story Land OE, 50th Park Icons/EARidescent/resort 50th pins. Many holiday/Halloween series are Disney Parks-wide (DL+WDW). Leads not recorded as pins (members unnamed): Princess 2022 portrait/pose OE line ($14.99, seen at DHS), Droid Builders 3 OE pins ($9.99), Princess Castle Booster (7 OE, spotted Disneyland Mar 2022). Conflicts kept: Jasmine 12.99 vs 9.99; Princess mystery 17.99 vs 22.99; HTH 2020 count 6 vs 7. Disney Springs-specific OE designs for 2021-2022 not found beyond Pin Traders sightings.
